evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: In the gathering cells, target-question failure varied across models; in the provision cells, where arms are directly comparable, failure rose for every model.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Rankings differ across cells, and competitive FAQ interruption produced 30/30 provision-coverage failures for all four models (Wilson 95% CI: 88.6-100.0%; baseline 0/30 for three, 4/30 for Llama).

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Interruption robustness therefore cannot be a single score: evaluation must be content-grounded, reported per cell, and matched to the deployment's interruption profile.
